people.name: Gomorrah
people.line: Wicked city destroyed by God along with Sodom.

people.name: Sodom
people.line: Wicked city destroyed by God for its sins

translations.web: Hear Yahweh’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
translations.bsb: Hear the word of the LORD, you rulers of Sodom; listen to the instruction of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
translations.kjv: Hear the word of the LORD, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.
translations.asv: Hear the word of Jehovah, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.
